features.title: Model Registry
features.description: Central registry of available models with capabilities, pricing, and provider metadata. Loads model definitions from a data-driven JSON config file at .claude/config/model-registry.json. Provides lookup by name, filtering by provider, and cost-optimized selection for a given capability requirement. Integrates with the existing MODEL_ALIASES and MODEL_PRICING constants from agent-config-reader.cjs and token-accountant.cjs respectively, serving as the single source of truth for model metadata across the routing system.

Existing MODEL_PRICING in token-accountant.cjs and MODEL_ALIASES in agent-config-reader.cjs serve as reference data to seed the registry

features.title: Cost Predictor
features.description: Pre-task cost estimation engine that combines token estimation with model pricing data to predict the cost of running a prompt against a specific model. Uses the existing estimateTokens() function from token-budget-tracker.cjs for character-to-token conversion and retrieves pricing from the ModelRegistry. Provides budget-aware model suggestion that recommends the cheapest model meeting a quality threshold, and exposes burn rate calculation for active sessions by querying the TokenAccountant's session totals.
preconditions: model-registry feature must be implemented (provides pricing data)
token-accountant.cjs TokenAccountant class is available for session cost queries

features.title: Provider Compatibility Layer
features.description: Normalizes model capabilities across different LLM providers into a unified interface. Currently the system is Anthropic-only, but this layer prepares for multi-provider support by abstracting provider-specific model configurations into a standard format. It maps provider-specific feature names to canonical feature identifiers (e.g., Anthropic 'extended_thinking' → canonical 'reasoning'), validates that a model supports a requested feature, and returns a normalized capability object that other routing modules can depend on without provider awareness.

features.title: Dynamic Model Router
features.description: Runtime model selection engine that integrates intent classification, cost prediction, and budget constraints to select the optimal model for each task. Extends the existing intent→agent→model resolution chain (from agent-config-reader.cjs resolveAgentModel) by adding cost-aware overrides: when budget is low, it can downgrade from opus to sonnet or sonnet to haiku while maintaining minimum quality thresholds. The router consumes the existing classifyIntent() output from intent-classifier.cjs to determine task complexity, then applies cost and budget constraints from the CostPredictor and ModelRegistry.
preconditions: agent-config-reader.cjs resolveAgentModel() is available for baseline model selection
provider-compat feature is recommended but not strictly required

features.title: Budget Engine
features.description: Session-level and project-level budget enforcement with automatic model downgrade. Extends the existing BudgetEnforcementService (TPM rate limiting) and token-budget-tracker (per-agent tracking) into a comprehensive cost control system. Manages budget allocation across pipeline phases (spec/planning/coding/qa from phase-models.json), monitors real-time spend via the TokenAccountant, and triggers automatic model downgrades when spend exceeds configurable thresholds. When budget is fully exhausted, throws a BudgetExhaustedError that the routing system can catch to halt operations gracefully.
preconditions: cost-predictor feature is recommended for burn rate calculations
budget-enforcement.cjs BudgetEnforcementService is available (for TPM integration)
